name: Disable Prefetcher
description: Disables the Windows Prefetcher service to reduce background preloading activity and potential compatibility issues.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Windows Prefetcher service to reduce background preloading activity and potential compatibility issues.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Windows-Prefetcher-Dienst, um Hintergrund-Vorladetätigkeiten und potenzielle Kompatibilitätsprobleme zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le service Préchargeur de Windows pour réduire l'activité d'enregistrement en arrière-plan et les problèmes de compatibilité potentiels.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value EnablePrefetcher in HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters to set it to 0 (disabled) or 3 (fully disabled)
